title: Building access and badges
title_cz: Přístup do budovy a identifikační karty

vocabulary.example: You need an access badge to enter the building.
vocabulary.example_cz: Pro vstup do budovy potřebuješ přístupovou kartu.
vocabulary.tts_text: You need an access badge to enter the building.

vocabulary.example: Swipe your card at the turnstile.
vocabulary.tts_text: Swipe your card at the turnstile.

vocabulary.example: Visitors must sign in at the reception desk.
vocabulary.example_cz: Návštěvníci se musí zapsat na recepci.
vocabulary.tts_text: Visitors must sign in at the reception desk.

vocabulary.example: I'll arrange a visitor pass for you.
vocabulary.tts_text: I'll arrange a visitor pass for you.

vocabulary.example: Ask the security guard for a temporary pass.
vocabulary.example_cz: Zeptej se bezpečnostního pracovníka na dočasnou kartu.
vocabulary.tts_text: Ask the security guard for a temporary pass.

vocabulary.example: The server room is a restricted area.
vocabulary.tts_text: The server room is a restricted area.

vocabulary.example: If your badge is lost, report it immediately.
vocabulary.example_cz: Pokud ztratíš kartu, okamžitě to nahlas.
vocabulary.tts_text: If your badge is lost, report it immediately.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think I lost my badge somewhere.
lines.text_cz: Myslím, že jsem někde ztratil svou kartu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You should report it immediately to the security guard.
lines.text_cz: Měl bys to okamžitě nahlásit bezpečnostnímu pracovníkovi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I get a temporary visitor pass for today?
lines.text_cz: Můžu dnes dostat dočasnou návštěvnickou kartu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, just sign in at the reception desk first.
lines.text_cz: Ano, nejprve se stačí zapsat na recepci.
